'''Polycarbonate''' was a light-weight material which was used to make the furniture of the [[AO14 net gun]] produced by [[Palandrix Personal Protection Gear]]. It was available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ETU" />

==Behind the scenes==
Polycarbonate was first mentioned in ''[[A Free-Trader's Guide to the Planets]]'', an article published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' ''10'']] in [[May]] [[1996]] by [[West End Games]].
